description: Abstract class for processing forms within the Goteo project, implementing form creation, validation, data handling, and image processing.

classes.name: AbstractFormProcessor
classes.description: An abstract class that provides form processing functionalities such as form creation, validation, data management, and image handling for the Goteo project.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the form processor with a form builder, model, and options.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Placeholder method for subclasses to add form fields.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Retrieves default form data, optionally sanitized.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Returns the form object, initializing and optionally submitting defaults if errors are to be shown.

methods.name: setModel
methods.description: Associates a data model with the form processor.

methods.name: setReadonly
methods.description: Sets the form to read-only mode.

methods.name: getReadonly
methods.description: Checks if the form is in read-only mode.

methods.name: setFullValidation
methods.description: Enables full validation and error display options.

methods.name: getFullValidation
methods.description: Checks if full validation is enabled.

methods.name: showErrors
methods.description: Determines if form errors should be displayed.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Sets configuration options for the form processor.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves a specific option by key.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves form data into the model, throwing exceptions on errors.

methods.name: processImageChange
methods.description: Handles image data changes, including removal and upload processing.
